# What an import of a plugin's scheme refuses, each at the import or the
# gen.scheme it is about.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

# A scheme nothing serves: no importer is built in for it and no package the
# program imports declares it.
! sngl check unknown/app.sngl
stderr 'unknown/app.sngl:1:1: import "nosuch:thing": unknown import scheme "nosuch": no built-in importer serves it, and no package this one imports declares it with gen.scheme'

# A plugin may not take a built-in scheme's name: a scheme is a dispatch key
# every import of the build shares.
! sngl check shadow/app.sngl
stderr 'go.sngl:3:1: scheme "go" is built into the compiler, and a plugin may not take its name'

# Nor the name of one the library ships.
! sngl check shadowlib/app.sngl
stderr 'c.sngl:3:1: scheme "c" is shipped by the library \(sngl:x/scheme/c\), and a plugin may not take its name'

# Two packages one import reaches may not both declare a name; the import that
# brings the second is the one reported, naming both.
! sngl check dup/app.sngl
stderr 'dup/app.sngl:3:1: import "\./two" brings a second scheme "dup": it is declared at one.sngl:3:1 and at two.sngl:3:1'

# A plugin may not use a scheme it declares.
! sngl check self/app.sngl
stderr 'self.sngl:2:1: import "self:x" uses the scheme "self" this package declares at self.sngl:4:1: a plugin may not use a scheme it declares'

# Two plugins each using the other's scheme import each other, and the import
# that closes the cycle is the one reported -- not the scheme it left
# unresolved.
! sngl check cycle/app.sngl
stderr 'b.sngl:2:1: import cycle detected: "\.\./a"'
! stderr 'unknown import scheme'

# A gen.scheme is read at the root of a file, and nowhere else.
! sngl check nested/app.sngl
stderr 'nested.sngl:5:[0-9]+: gen.scheme may only be written at the root of a file'

# A raise that leaves the handler is an error at the import, carrying its
# message.
! sngl check raise/app.sngl
stderr 'raise/app.sngl:1:1: import "boom:x": scheme "boom": no such thing as x'

# A handler is gated like any build-time SNGL: an unasked command is refused,
# and the refusal is reported at the import that ran the plugin.
! sngl check exec/app.sngl
stderr 'exec/app.sngl:1:1: import "run:x": pc/pc.sngl:4:13: \./pc may not run sh -c ''echo hi'': running it needs --allow-command="\./pc=sh"'
sngl check --allow-command='./pc=sh' exec/app.sngl

-- unknown/app.sngl --
import x "nosuch:thing"

const v = 1
-- shadow/app.sngl --
import "./go"

const v = 1
-- shadow/go/go.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="go", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
})
-- shadowlib/app.sngl --
import "./c"

const v = 1
-- shadowlib/c/c.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="c", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
})
-- dup/app.sngl --
import x "dup:x"
import "./one"
import "./two"

const v = x.v
-- dup/one/one.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="dup", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
})
-- dup/two/two.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="dup", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 2\n")
})
-- self/app.sngl --
import "./self"

const v = 1
-- self/self/self.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import x "self:x"

gen.scheme(name="self", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
})
-- cycle/app.sngl --
import "./a"

const v = 1
-- cycle/a/a.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import y "b:y"
import "../b"

gen.scheme(name="a", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
})
-- cycle/b/b.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import "../a"
import x "a:x"

gen.scheme(name="b", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
})
-- nested/app.sngl --
import "./nested"

const v = 1
-- nested/nested/nested.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component c ui.node {
    gen.scheme(name="n", @generate(out, importPath) {
        out.write("x.sngl", "const v = 1\n")
    })
}
-- raise/app.sngl --
import x "boom:x"
import "./boom"

const v = 1
-- raise/boom/boom.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="boom", @generate(out, importPath) {
    error.raise("no such thing as " + importPath, "missing")
})
-- exec/app.sngl --
import x "run:x"
import "./pc"

const v = x.line
-- exec/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="run", @generate(out, importPath) {
    var p = gen.exec(cmd=["sh", "-c", "echo hi"])
    var line = ""
    for var l = p.stdout {
        line = l
    }
    out.write("x.sngl", "const line = \"" + line + "\"\n")
})
